exposure: glycemic variability (GV) during pre- and periconception period
cohort: The study included 29 women (with 38 pregnancies) who have type 1 diabetes.
finding: Women with a total complication score greater than 3 had a significantly higher Average Daily Risk Range (ADRR) at conception, suggesting an association between glycemic variability and pregnancy/perinatal complications depending on the period and GV metrics used.
